message: Hi, I'm a student with a full stack certification background. My overall academic average is 79.1% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in networks and cloud computing. I want to become a Applications Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 28400 per year. I live in Hyderabad. I'm open to going abroad.

other_constraints: Interested in networks and cloud computing
